messages:
Tessa (NewClient): Hey team — onboarding warmup is flakey. We get a mix of 401s saying "missing auth header" and 429 spikes when our CI fanout runs. Started after we added an internal proxy. Staging only.
Diego (CSM): thanks @Tessa. Which SDK + token issuer? can you paste a tiny log and your SDK init? looping in @Maya and @Ava.
Tessa (NewClient): Node SDK v2.2.1. tokens from our ephemeral-token service. SDK init: `new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })`. Log: `POST /v1/embeddings 401 {id:"req_xx", error:"unauthorized", hint:"missing auth header"}`. curl with the same token on the runner works.
Maya (SDK): two likely issues: 1) header being stripped/encoded by proxy 2) very short TTLs + clock skew causing some requests to be unauthorized. Also our older retry default treats `Retry-After: 0` as immediate retry which can amplify 429s.
Tessa (NewClient): our proxy does rewrite headers to be safe: `encodeURIComponent()` on values. could that break things?
Ava (SRE): yes — encoding will change the token. I just pulled traces; inbound Authorization is raw but outbound from proxy shows `%2B` and `%3D` sequences. that would cause signature mismatch -> 401.
Maya (SDK): that explains 401s. For the 429s, set retry with `respectRetryAfter:true` and lower attempts during warmup, plus add startup jitter. example: `retry:{maxAttempts:3,respectRetryAfter:true,minTimeout:300}` and add randomized 0..250ms splay before each worker starts.
Tessa (NewClient): ok removing encoding for Authorization and adding jitter. token TTL is 2m now — should we increase?
Diego (CSM): for large parallel fanouts we recommend >=5m or implement per-worker refresh. i'll open an ops ticket for a temporary onboarding bump while you stabilize.
OpsBot: Ops request created: OPS-6001 "NewClient onboarding temporary throttle"  assignee: infra-ops.
Tessa (NewClient): patched proxy and added 0..200ms jitter, bumped TTL to 10min for onboarding. re-ran 4 warmups: 401s gone, 429s down from ~18% to ~2%. thanks!
Maya (SDK): will add a short onboarding note in the README about header pass-through and splay. also backport a small retry fix so `Retry-After: 0` maps to a small default backoff.
Ava (SRE): I'll monitor traces for 24h and watch OPS-6001. if you need long-term help we can review token exchange patterns.
Diego (CSM): action items: 1) Tessa — stop encoding Authorization, keep TTL bump and splay (Tessa) 2) Maya — docs + retry backport (Maya) 3) Ava — monitor OPS-6001 (Ava). closing once stable. :white_check_mark:
